concept: DR strategies: Multi-Site Active/Active (Global Tables + Route 53)
tests: Building a multi-Region active/active setup with near-zero RTO/RPO (choose two).
expected: DynamoDB Global Tables (multi-active replication) + Route 53 latency/failover routing with health checks. Triggers: "two Regions simultaneously", "near-zero RTO and RPO", "automatic regional failover".
why_not: RDS Single-AZ with manual cross-Region snapshots has high RPO/RTO, not active/active; a single EC2 with an EIP has no multi-Region resilience.
